column3: The four metrics and the claim of outperforming earlier models are retained despite awkward wording for models.
Retains the three exceptional coherence levels, their specific datasets and what both graphical marks mean.
The walking count has become a step count, changing what the phone data represent. The second sentence retains location, weather and street vitality.
Correct modality, anatomical scale, axial resolution and penetration range.
Describes a greater number of colored colors rather than the degree of chromaticity, although the prediction qualifier survives.
The hypothetical advantage and both senses are understandable.
Water withdrawals become exits, and deficit irrigation becomes inadequate practice, losing the comparison with water requirements.
The numerical exceptions are present but the coherence condition and error bars are rendered as ordinary agreement and errors.
Preserves the proposed reporting bias and the desire to please the instructor.
Failed replication and the uncertainty about optimal integration remain distinct.
Keeps the two inclusion thresholds with the correct units and populations.
The perceptual discrimination threshold becomes a prejudice threshold. Other participants and the supplementary reference remain accurate.
The teachers and assignments survive. Shared slides across classes become commonly used slides, weakening the stated control.
The named coefficient kc,mid is changed to kc,mids at both occurrences.
Preserves the lower perceptual threshold, lack of substantial speed loss, the other participants and the figure reference.
One scan is the comparator and both metrics improve across all models.
Subthreshold becomes a base threshold, changing the contrast between signals below and above threshold.
Correct population, study practices and focus on the two behaviors.
Correct students and learning behavior, with the two-behavior qualifier.
Both alternatives and the Actigraph comparison are expressed.
The disease description is accurate. Broken citation and clause structure obscure who regarded physical activity as part of care.
The percentage and direction survive but discrimination is rendered as prejudice, losing the perceptual endpoint.
Both the characterization purpose and the proposed design application are retained; strength is rendered somewhat broadly.
Single- and double-opponent cell types become single and double pairs of cells; the color channels are otherwise clear.
Combines percent and tonnes into the malformed unit “48%吨”, obscuring the denominator despite naming the crops.
The translated measurement name implies thermal gravity rather than thermogravimetry. Panel B's two material classes are right.
All metric names, exact values and comparison with previous models survive.
The radiation variable SLR becomes a single-lens reflex camera, despite correct numerical readings.
Both thresholds and their eligibility roles are discernible despite awkward word order.
Correct opposition of subthreshold and suprathreshold activity.
The plot becomes a land parcel, so the reference to the bottom of the charts is misleading.
The model, Poisson drive and gradient reconstruction are preserved, as are local rules and both absent computing components.
The first sentence drops thermal properties apart from stability; PLA becomes the People's Liberation Army in the research objective.
Retains the causal explanation as phrased in the source and opposite changes in free volume and stiffness.
Correct water withdrawals, deficit irrigation and explanation of the shortfall.
The color-opponent channels become adversaries; the reconstruction and linear combination are otherwise present.
Volume in cubic kilometers becomes an area with a trailing three, and water requirements become funding.
Correct ablation design and single-task comparator.
Links environmental damage from petroleum-based polymers to research into renewable, biodegradable composites.
Both radiation measurements lose the hour in watt-hours per square meter, changing energy per area to power per area.
The measurement label says thermal gravity rather than thermogravimetry; the materials in panel B remain identifiable.
Preserves shortwave versus other loads, the limited marginal benefit, and its two conditions.
Correct allocation of teachers and groups and clear account of the common teaching materials.
Surface free energy becomes absence of surface energy and dispersive energy becomes astigmatism.
Numbers are visible but the syntax does not tell the reader how temperature varies between panels and SLR between lines.
Preserves the ductile fracture, both temperature decreases, higher crystallinity and inference about flexibility.
Moderate, mild and severe MS are placed in the correct order of correlations.
Gives the reason for clipping the chart and both correctly assigned axis ranges.
The Actigraph metrics and the similar-or-stronger comparison remain intelligible.
The two windows and size remain but fixation to the cranium is lost and the description of ventilation is misleading.
The model's type is misspelled as Sping. The second sentence correctly gives its architectural features.
Accurately describes the disease and the contrast between lower activity and its perceived health benefits.
Correctly retains both extremes of urban form and the consistent sky-openness modifier.
Urban form, a spatial variable, becomes urban formation, a process.
Correct Bayesian trade-off, comparator and purpose of testing additional parameters.
Changes increasing chromaticity into a larger number of hues while preserving the parenthetical comparison.
The retained abbreviations preserve the variables and both halves of the physical finding.
Identifies perfect agreement and the indicated black diagonal.
Loses the strong end of the correlation range and renders measurement agreement as a contract.
The decoder ablation and single-task comparison are discernible.
Defines irrigation withdrawals as financial withdrawals in both sentences, changing the quantity being defined.
All three named coefficients and both directions of linear change are preserved.
No translation was returned.
The language is wooden but both urban-form extremes and positive sky-openness effect can be read.
Retains fit versus complexity and the test of whether extra parameters improve the fit.
Agreement becomes a legal agreement and lying along a line becomes a downward trend.
Correct cause of rising research interest and the two material attributes.
The estimated volume, cubic unit, spatial variation and monthly variation survive.
Correct ordering of the three severity strata and supplementary table.
Retains the one-scan comparator, all models and both image metrics.
Adds a monthly mean that is absent from “monthly harvested”, changing how the area is aggregated.
Both physical changes and the authors' explanation are recognizable.
Preserves the walking count, modeled shade and weather; the second sentence is awkward but identifies setting, season and research question.
Replaces watt-hours with watts per square meter, changing the reported physical dimension.
Correct OCT technique and both resolution and penetration measurements.
Correct direction of potential reporting bias and its social motivation.
Correct year, share, mass-based denominator and identity of the four crops.
Correct hypothetical comparison and both sensory sources.
Keeps both percentage ranges attached to the correct study practices.
Defines agricultural water withdrawals correctly and accounts for crop demand and system losses.
Correct combined and vestibular thresholds, direction, coherence level and figures; substantially describes magnitude here.
Correctly describes both the self-supervised method and the smaller decoder's performance and efficiency.
Preserves the joint role of microclimate and urban form and the empirical framing.
Correct measurement and materials in both caption panels.
Both components of the PLA surface-energy measurement and Table 2 are identifiable; 色散分量 would be more idiomatic.
Omits the double-opponent cell class and mistranslates the remaining class as a pair of opponents.
The failed replication and uncertainty regarding optimal combination are intact.
Distinguishes correlation from agreement and preserves the range of correlations and three sources of variation.
Denoising is mistranslated as disposal; the second sentence retains the decoder comparison and efficiency finding.
The count, model and weather are preserved. The setting and seasonal street-vitality question are readable despite stiffness.
Ductile fracture becomes fracture of cocci, changing the reported material behavior.
Correct preparation and performance comparisons and the qualified hypothesis about study habits.
Changes academic grades to levels and spaced learning to physical distance, losing the meaning of the group comparison.
The clinical impairments and the two contrasting claims about physical activity are both preserved.
Correct study years, intervention population and classification by URM status.
Says the cells themselves are reconstructed rather than the double-opponent channel, although the rest of the computation is clear.
Correct display rationale and separately assigned axis limits.
Awkward but both urban-form extremes and the consistent effect of greater sky openness are intact.
Preserves the source's anesthesia, ventilation, fixation, number, size and bilateral placement.
The preparation and outcome comparisons and qualified explanation through study habits remain understandable.
Correct years, intervention sections and classification variable.
